description: Canonical dog breed taxonomy used to normalize breed labels across datasets, model outputs, the knowledge base, and the API.

special_classes.description: Used when the system cannot confidently map an image to a supported breed.
Used when visual evidence suggests multiple breed similarities and a reliable purebred classification cannot be made.

breed_schema.dataset_labels: Original labels used by individual datasets.
breed_schema.origin_country: Country of breed origin when verified.
breed_schema.origin_region: More specific origin region when verified.
breed_schema.breed_group: Breed group or classification when available.
breed_schema.supported_by_model: Whether the current production classifier directly supports this breed.
breed_schema.knowledge_available: Whether structured breed knowledge has been added.
